prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a glossy black spider seen from the side in a low wide stance, a big round shiny black abdomen with a bright red hourglass mark on its side, a small head with a cluster of tiny red eyes and two short fangs, exactly eight long thin jointed black legs, the two front legs raised. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: a small cluster of tiny red eyes and the two fangs are readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging forward low toward the heroes, the two front legs reaching out and the fangs bared, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the body tipped up, the legs curling in, the front legs thrown up, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Lower or raise the body along a strong diagonal, extend the fangs, pincers or stinger far toward the heroes, and splay the legs while their tips stay on the ground line. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, seen from the side, legs spread, every leg tip on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, hair, fur, a web, a human face, more than eight legs.
